controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Cassini I/F observations projected onto the released shape. Bounded photometric normalization reduces broad acquired shading; true cast shadows and unreliable geometry are withheld. Gray grid marks unobserved areas.
controls.summary: Photographs are mapped onto the measured shape. Shadows and unreliable samples are withheld; the gray grid marks gaps.
controls.title: ISS mosaic

controls.label: Filter color
controls.description: Cassini IR3, GRN, UV3 filters displayed as red, green and blue; observed illumination and common coverage only.
controls.summary: False color from separately registered filters. Gray grid marks missing common coverage; photographed shadows remain.
controls.title: Cassini filter color

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radial height above a 15.1 km reference sphere from the Cassini shape model. This includes the broad irregular shape; it is not height above a gravity-defined geoid. Fixed relief lighting shows slopes; shape uncertainties vary by region.
controls.summary: Height relative to a 15.1 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Accuracy varies by region.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
